import urllib.request,urllib.error,json,datetime
base='https://app.ontrackegy.com/saas/mobile/'
out={}
for name,field,expected in [('updates/latest.json','revision',10),('updates/native/latest.json','version_code',15)]:
 with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(base+name,headers={'Cache-Control':'no-store'}),timeout=10) as r:
  data=json.loads(r.read(16384));status=r.status
 meta=json.loads(data['payload'])
 assert status==200 and int(meta[field])==expected
 asset='updates/'+('native/' if field=='version_code' else '')+meta['file']
 with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(base+asset,method='HEAD'),timeout=10) as r:
  asset_http=r.status;length=int(r.headers.get('Content-Length','0'));ct=r.headers.get('Content-Type','')
 assert asset_http==200 and length==meta['size']
 out[name]={'http':status,'asset_http':asset_http,'size':length,'sha256':meta['sha256'],'content_type':ct}
for filename,method,expected in [('calls.php','GET',403),('call_event.php','POST',401)]:
 req=urllib.request.Request(base+filename,method=method,data=b'{}' if method=='POST' else None,headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'})
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=8) as r:status=r.status
 except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:status=e.code
 assert status==expected
 out[filename]={'http_unauthenticated':status}
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','checks':out,'checked_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()}))
